content.title: Grupo Simec: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: GUADALAJARA, Mexico (AP) — Grupo Simec SAB de CV (SIM) on Wednesday reported a loss of $51.3 million in its second quarter. On a per-share basis, the Guadalajara, Mexico-based company said it had a loss of 31 cents. The steel producer posted revenue of $361.8 million in the period.

content.title: Grupo Simec: Q1 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: GUADALAJARA, Mexico (AP) — Grupo Simec SAB de CV (SIM) on Thursday reported earnings of $63.9 million in its first quarter. On a per-share basis, the Guadalajara, Mexico-based company said it had net income of 38 cents. The steel producer posted revenue of $380.9 million in the period.
